issues.finding: The paper lists two separate events: review of alternative service resumes (case 27); the engineer reapplies to renounce citizenship (case 10). The existing Chinese and English essays mistakenly made the engineer's application concern alternative service.

issues.correction_en: Review of alternative service resumed. Separately, the engineer reapplied to relinquish citizenship and was later permitted to do so.
